notes:
- NEW: a Game Optimization tab that tunes each of your games separately
- Finds games automatically from Steam, Epic, Ubisoft, GOG, EA, Battle.net and Xbox
- A performance-to-quality slider that shows exactly what it would change before you apply anything
- Per-game NVIDIA driver settings: power mode, low latency, V-Sync and texture filtering
- In-game settings for Unreal Engine, Unity and Source games, plus Rainbow Six Siege and Minecraft
- Every change is backed up first and can be undone from the History tab
- Anything your driver or game will not allow is shown as unavailable rather than pretending to work
- Game settings files keep their original format, so nothing gets corrupted
